headline: GOLD CLINGS TO $4,000 AS FED MEETING KICKS OFF — Silver Slips to 2026 Low, G/S Ratio Stretches Toward 75; Physical Buyers Step In on Dip
snippet: Gold held $4,026.55 (+0.24%) on Tuesday as the Federal Reserve opened its two-day policy meeting, while silver fell to $53.82 — pushing the gold-to-silver ratio toward 75, up from roughly 60 at the start of 2026. Last week's 4% gold drop, the worst in four months, has drawn physical buyers treating the break as an accumulation window.

headline: ENERGY FUELS LANDS A$180M GOVERNMENT BACKING for Donald Rare Earth Project — Export Finance Australia + NRF Fund 40-Year Mine; FID Targeted Year-End 2026
snippet: Energy Fuels received conditional credit approvals totalling A$180 million for Phase 1 of its Donald rare earth project in Victoria — A$70M from Export Finance Australia and A$110M from the National Reconstruction Fund. Phase 1 targets 9,000 tonnes per year of REE concentrate over a 40-year mine life, with a final investment decision expected by end of 2026.

headline: FIREFLY METALS HITS 22.5M AT 2.5% COPPER EQUIVALENT in New VMS Discovery — Step-Out Cuts 40m of Sulphides, Assays Pending; 2.6km From Idle Mill
snippet: FireFly Metals (TSX:FFM) announced a new VMS copper-gold discovery at its Mount Joy prospect within Green Bay, Newfoundland — hole FFR26-071 returned 22.5m at 2.5% CuEq including a high-grade 9.0m core at 3.9% CuEq. A step-out hole hit approximately 40m of semi-massive sulphides with assays pending, and the target sits just 2.6km from the idle Nugget Pond Mill.

headline: SANKAMAP METALS DISCOVERS 1,000M HIGH-GRADE GOLD SYSTEM AT NORTH FAURO — Completely Undrilled Surface Target Opens New Priority on Solomon Islands Project (CSE:SCU)
snippet: Sankamap Metals (CSE:SCU) reported a new hydrothermal gold system extending over approximately 1,000 metres at its North Fauro property in the Solomon Islands, defined entirely from surface sampling with no drill holes yet completed. The discovery represents a high-priority maiden drill target at an otherwise untested project.

headline: LAHONTAN GOLD WRAPS 31-HOLE SANTA FE CAMPAIGN — New Slab West Zone Found; 17 Holes Still Awaiting Assay at Nevada Gold Project (TSX-V:LG)
snippet: Lahontan Gold completed 31 reverse-circulation holes totalling 7,497 metres at its Santa Fe project in Nevada, with results received on 14 holes and 17 still pending assay. The program uncovered a new gold zone at Slab West, expanding the project's footprint beyond the known resource area.

headline: MALAYSIA CLEARS FIRST RARE EARTH EXPORT TO U.S. — DTEC Gets Permit for 700 Tonnes of Carbonate from Perak State; 30-Tonne Initial Shipment Imminent
snippet: DTEC Mineral and Metal Technology received a Malaysian government permit to export up to 700 metric tonnes of rare earth carbonate from Perak state to the United States for research purposes, with a 30-tonne initial shipment expected imminently. It is the first publicly confirmed rare earth material flow from Malaysia to the U.S. under new supply-chain diversification efforts.

headline: LARAMIDE LEADS URANIUM TSX GAINERS OCT. 27 — NexGen, Global Atomic and Uranium Energy Corp Also in Focus as Sector Rotates Higher
snippet: Laramide Resources topped the TSX Venture gainers list on October 27 as uranium equities moved broadly higher in a sector rotation. NexGen Energy, Global Atomic, and Uranium Energy Corp were among the names in focus as investors returned to uranium after recent weakness.

headline: CHINA'S YANGSHAN COPPER PREMIUM HITS $178/T — Highest Level Since 2014 as Import Demand Surges; Comex Holds Near $6.63/lb
snippet: The Yangshan copper premium — a gauge of Chinese appetite for imported metal — reached $178 per tonne, its highest since 2014, signalling a surge in Chinese physical demand that is keeping copper supported near $6.63/lb on Comex. Ongoing mine disruptions and constrained global supply are adding structural tightness alongside the demand uptick.

headline: SIGMA LITHIUM BUYS SIX MORE MONTHS ON $142M DEBT — Synergy Capital Extension Bridges Gap After Brazil Court Restores Grota do Cirilo Licences
snippet: Sigma Lithium extended the maturity of approximately $142 million in debt by six months to June 2027 in a deal with Synergy Capital, buying breathing room after Brazil's Federal Court of Appeals reinstated its Grota do Cirilo operating licences. The mine restarted October 5 and produced 7,090 tonnes of lithium concentrate in its first 16 days back in operation.

headline: GRANDICH: GOLD, SILVER AND URANIUM ALL FLASHING BUY — Veteran Commentator Calls Multi-Year Setup with Specific Entry and Risk Levels After Sector Selloff
snippet: Veteran mining commentator Peter Grandich argues that gold, silver, and uranium are all setting up for significant moves based on technical patterns and central bank accumulation, and provides specific entry points and risk levels for retail investors. The piece offers a contrarian take against current sector pessimism following the recent gold correction from highs near $4,500.

headline: ASX RARE EARTH TRIO SURGES 12-15% IN ONE SESSION — Alvo Minerals Drills Brazil, Victory Metals Secures WA Mining Lease, Dateline Resources Joins Rally
snippet: Alvo Minerals (+15.79%), Victory Metals (+14%), and Dateline Resources (+12.68%) all surged in a single ASX session on October 26. Alvo initiated drilling at its Florence rare earth prospect in Brazil, while Victory Metals announced it secured Mining Lease M20/564 covering 2,006 hectares at its North Stanmore Heavy Rare Earth Project in Western Australia.
